name: Sika Boom® Cleaner
tagline: Cleaner for Sika Boom® application guns
summary: Sika Boom® Cleaner is an active cleaner for cleaning Sika Boom® application guns and fresh Sika Boom® residue from surfaces.
metaDescription: Sika Boom® Cleaner is an active cleaner for cleaning Sika Boom® application guns and fresh Sika Boom® residue from surfaces.
attributes: Very good PU spray gun and equipment cleaner
usage: Clean Sika® PU foam application equipment after use.
Removes fresh, uncured polyurethane foam residue from equipment and other surfaces, as well as cleaning and removing grease from contaminated substrates.
advantages: Very good PU spray gun and equipment cleaner
packaging: 500 ml pressurised container (can), 12 containers per box.

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: 18 months from the date of production. Must be used within 4 weeks.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +25 °C. Store in an upright position. Always refer to packaging.
